<html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:'Nunito',system-ui,sans-serif;}
:root{--navy:#1a1a3d;--purple:#5b3a9e;--purple2:#7b52c7;--gold:#e8b93c;--gold2:#c99a2e;}
html,body{height:100%;}
body{background:#0d0d24;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;}
.phone{width:340px;height:720px;background:#111;border-radius:36px;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid #333;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);}
/* On an actual phone screen, drop the mockup frame and fill the real viewport edge to edge */
@media (max-width:480px){
  body{
    padding:0;
    align-items:stretch;
  }

  .phone{
    width:100vw;
    height:100vh;
    height:100dvh;
    border-radius:0;
    border:none;
    box-shadow:none;
  }

  .topbar{
    padding-top:max(24px, calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top)));
  }

  .detail-header{
    padding-top:max(24px, calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top)));
  }

  .bottom-nav{
    padding-bottom:max(12px, calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)));
  }

  .splash-footer{
    padding-bottom:max(18px, calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)));
  }
}
.screen{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;}
.screen.active{display:flex;}

/* SPLASH */
#splash{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,10,45,0.35) 0%,rgba(15,8,35,0.55) 45%,rgba(10,6,28,0.92) 100%),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center 40%;}
.splash-inner{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding:36px 24px 12px;}
.eco-badge{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);}
.splash-title{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:white;text-align:center;line-height:1.15;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);}
.splash-sub{font-size:12px;color:#e6d9ff;margin-top:6px;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);}
.splash-icons{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-top:20px;}
.s-ico{width:44px;height:44px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(2px);}
.splash-welcome{margin-top:22px;background:rgba(10,6,28,0.55);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;width:100%;text-align:center;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);}
.splash-welcome-lbl{color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;}
.splash-welcome-txt{color:white;font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.6;opacity:0.95;}
.get-started{margin:20px 24px 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--purple2));color:white;border:none;border-radius:16px;padding:14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;width:calc(100% - 48px);cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(91,58,158,0.5);}
.splash-footer{background:rgba(0,0,0,0.45);padding:14px 28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:16px;}
.sf-item{text-align:center;}
.sf-lbl{color:var(--gold);font-size:9px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;}
.sf-val{color:white;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;margin-top:2px;}

/* MAIN HOME */
#main{background:#f4f2fa;flex-direction:column;}
.topbar{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy),var(--purple));padding:10px 14px 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-shrink:0;}
.topbar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.tb-dot{width:28px;height:28px;background:rgba(232,185,60,0.25);border:1px solid rgba(232,185,60,0.5);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;}
.tb-brand{color:white;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;}
.tb-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);font-size:9px;font-weight:400;}
.lang-btns{display:flex;gap:4px;}
.lb{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border:none;color:white;font-size:9px;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;}
.lb.on{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy);}
.cards-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;padding:12px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;}
.card{background:white;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(30,10,60,0.08);transition:transform 0.15s,box-shadow 0.15s;}
.card:active{transform:scale(0.95);box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);}
.card-emoji{font-size:26px;line-height:1;}
.card-label{font-size:9px;color:#444;text-align:center;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;}
.card-color{width:100%;height:4px;border-radius:2px;margin-top:2px;}
.bottom-nav{background:white;border-top:1px solid #ece6f7;display:flex;padding:8px 0 6px;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 -2px 10px rgba(30,10,60,0.06);}
.nav-item{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;cursor:pointer;}
.nav-item span:first-child{font-size:18px;}
.nav-item span:last-child{font-size:8px;color:#888;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;}

/* DETAIL */
#detail{background:#f4f2fa;flex-direction:column;}
.detail-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;flex-shrink:0;}
.back-btn{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;color:white;}
.detail-title{color:white;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;}
.detail-emoji{font-size:22px;}
.detail-body{padding:14px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;}
.detail-card{background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(30,10,60,0.06);}
.detail-card h3{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;}
.detail-card p{font-size:12px;color:#555;line-height:1.7;}
.info-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:0.5px solid #f0f0f0;}
.info-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.info-dot{font-size:10px;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0;}
.info-text{font-size:12px;color:#444;line-height:1.5;}
.action-btn{width:100%;padding:13px;border-radius:14px;border:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px;}
.btn-purple{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--purple2));color:white;}
.btn-outline{background:white;color:var(--purple);border:2px solid var(--purple);}
.note-box{background:#f5f0ff;border-left:3px solid var(--purple);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px;color:#5b3a9e;line-height:1.6;}

/* POI CARD (used by all top-10 lists) */
.poi-card{background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(30,10,60,0.07);}
.poi-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.poi-rank{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px;}
.poi-icon{font-size:24px;flex-shrink:0;}
.poi-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#222;line-height:1.3;}
.poi-tag{font-size:9.5px;color:#8b6fc9;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;}
.poi-desc{font-size:12px;color:#555;line-height:1.6;margin:8px 0;}
.poi-why{background:#f5f0ff;border-left:3px solid var(--purple);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11.5px;color:#5b3a9e;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:9px;}
.poi-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;margin-bottom:9px;}
.poi-info-row{display:flex;gap:6px;font-size:11.5px;color:#444;line-height:1.5;}
.poi-info-row b{color:#222;flex-shrink:0;min-width:64px;}
.poi-dir-btn{width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:10px;border:none;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1e88e5,#1565c0);color:white;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;}
.cat-intro{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy),var(--purple));border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;color:white;}
.cat-intro h3{color:var(--gold);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.cat-intro p{font-size:11.5px;color:#eee0ff;line-height:1.6;}
.price-disclaimer{font-size:9.5px;color:#aaa;text-align:center;padding:6px 4px 2px;line-height:1.5;}
.sub-section-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;color:var(--purple);margin:16px 2px 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.sub-section-title:first-child{margin-top:2px;}
.step{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;align-items:flex-start;}
.step-num{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:white;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;background:var(--purple);}
.step-text{font-size:12px;color:#444;line-height:1.5;flex:1;}
</style>

<script>
function maps(q){return 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query='+encodeURIComponent(q);}
function dirBtn(q,label){label=label||'Get Directions';return '<button class="poi-dir-btn" onclick="window.open(\''+maps(q)+'\')">📍 '+label+'</button>';}

function poiCard(p,i){
  return '<div class="poi-card">'
  +'<div class="poi-head"><div class="poi-rank">'+(i+1)+'</div><div class="poi-icon">'+p.icon+'</div>'
  +'<div><div class="poi-name">'+p.name+'</div><div class="poi-tag">'+p.tag+'</div></div></div>'
  +'<div class="poi-desc">'+p.desc+'</div>'
  +'<div class="poi-why">💡 <b>Why go:</b> '+p.why+'</div>'
  +'<div class="poi-info">'
  +(p.price?'<div class="poi-info-row"><b>💵 Price</b><span>'+p.price+'</span></div>':'')
  +(p.booking?'<div class="poi-info-row"><b>📅 Booking</b><span>'+p.booking+'</span></div>':'')
  +'<div class="poi-info-row"><b>📍 Location</b><span>'+p.location+'</span></div>'
  +'</div>'
  +dirBtn(p.mapQuery)
  +'</div>';
}
function poiListHTML(arr){return arr.map((p,i)=>poiCard(p,i)).join('');}

function show(id){
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
}
function openModal(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show');}
function closeModal(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');}

function openDetail(key){
  const s=sections[key];
  const hdr=document.getElementById('detail-header');
  hdr.style.background=s.color;
  document.getElementById('back-btn').style.background=s.color;
  document.getElementById('detail-emoji').textContent=s.emoji;
  document.getElementById('dtitle').textContent=s.title.replace(/&amp;/g,'&');
  document.getElementById('dcontent').innerHTML=s.content;
  show('detail');
  if(key==='weather'){setTimeout(loadWeather,100);}
}

const T={
  en:{welcome:'Your Pass',activities:'Top Activities',waterfalls:'Top Waterfalls',restaurants:'Top Restaurants',springs:'Thermal Springs',ziplines:'Zip Lines',trails:'Hiking Trails',bridges:'Suspended Bridges',directions:'Getting Here',weather:'Weather',map:'Map & Distances',contact:'Support',shopping:'Where to Shop',stay:'Where to Stay',prepare:'Prepare Your Trip'},
  fr:{welcome:'Votre Passe',activities:'Meilleures Activités',waterfalls:'Meilleures Cascades',restaurants:'Meilleurs Restaurants',springs:'Sources Thermales',ziplines:'Tyroliennes',trails:'Sentiers de Randonnée',bridges:'Ponts Suspendus',directions:'S\'y Rendre',weather:'Météo',map:'Carte et Distances',contact:'Assistance',shopping:'Où Magasiner',stay:'Où Loger',prepare:'Préparer Son Voyage'},
  es:{welcome:'Tu Pase',activities:'Mejores Actividades',waterfalls:'Mejores Cataratas',restaurants:'Mejores Restaurantes',springs:'Aguas Termales',ziplines:'Canopy',trails:'Senderos',bridges:'Puentes Colgantes',directions:'Cómo Llegar',weather:'Clima',map:'Mapa y Distancias',contact:'Soporte',shopping:'Dónde Comprar',stay:'Dónde Alojarse',prepare:'Prepara Tu Viaje'}
};
function setLang(lang,btn){
  document.querySelectorAll('.lb').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'));
  btn.classList.add('on');
  const t=T[lang];
  Object.keys(t).forEach(k=>{const el=document.getElementById('lbl-'+k);if(el)el.textContent=t[k];});
}

/* WEATHER (La Fortuna coordinates) */
const WMO={0:'☀️ Clear',1:'🌤️ Mainly Clear',2:'⛅ Partly Cloudy',3:'☁️ Overcast',45:'🌫️ Foggy',51:'🌦️ Drizzle',53:'🌦️ Drizzle',55:'🌧️ Heavy Drizzle',61:'🌧️ Light Rain',63:'🌧️ Rain',65:'🌧️ Heavy Rain',80:'🌦️ Showers',81:'🌧️ Heavy Showers',95:'⛈️ Thunderstorm',99:'⛈️ Hail Storm'};
const WDAYS=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
function wDir(d){return['N','NE','E','SE','S','SW','W','NW'][Math.round(d/45)%8];}
function uvLbl(v){return v<=2?'Low':v<=5?'Moderate':v<=7?'High':v<=10?'Very High':'Extreme';}
function wIcon(code){return(WMO[code]||'⛅').split(' ')[0];}

function loadWeather(){
  const wx=document.getElementById('wx-wrap');
  if(!wx)return;
  fetch('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=10.4708&longitude=-84.6431&current=temperature_2m,weathercode,windspeed_10m,winddirection_10m,precipitation,uv_index&hourly=temperature_2m,weathercode,precipitation_probability&daily=weathercode,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max,windspeed_10m_max,winddirection_10m_dominant&timezone=America%2FCosta_Rica&forecast_days=7')
  .then(r=>r.json())
  .then(w=>{
    const c=w.current;
    const desc=WMO[c.weathercode]||'⛅ Cloudy';
    const uv=c.uv_index||0;
    let h='<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0288d1,#00acc1);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;color:white;">';
    h+='<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;">';
    h+='<div><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:0.8;margin-bottom:2px;">📍 La Fortuna, Costa Rica</div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:42px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;">'+Math.round(c.temperature_2m)+'°C</div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:4px;">'+desc+'</div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:11px;margin-top:8px;opacity:0.9;">💨 '+Math.round(c.windspeed_10m)+' km/h '+wDir(c.winddirection_10m)+'</div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:11px;opacity:0.9;">☔ '+c.precipitation+' mm, UV '+uvLbl(uv)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div style="font-size:52px;">'+wIcon(c.weathercode)+'</div></div></div>';
    const now=new Date();
    const nowH=now.getHours();
    const todayStr=now.toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const hrs=w.hourly.time.map((t,i)=>({t,tmp:w.hourly.temperature_2m[i],code:w.hourly.weathercode[i],pop:w.hourly.precipitation_probability[i]})).filter(x=>x.t.startsWith(todayStr)&&parseInt(x.t.slice(11,13))>=nowH).slice(0,6);
    if(hrs.length){
      h+='<div style="background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);">';
      h+='<div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#0288d1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:10px;">⏱ Hourly Forecast</div>';
      h+='<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px;">';
      hrs.forEach(x=>{
        const hr=parseInt(x.t.slice(11,13));
        h+='<div style="flex-shrink:0;text-align:center;background:#f5f0ff;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 6px;min-width:48px;">';
        h+='<div style="font-size:9px;color:#888;">'+(hr===nowH?'Now':hr+':00')+'</div>';
        h+='<div style="font-size:18px;margin:4px 0;">'+wIcon(x.code)+'</div>';
        h+='<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#333;">'+Math.round(x.tmp)+'°</div>';
        h+='<div style="font-size:9px;color:#0288d1;">'+x.pop+'%</div></div>';
      });
      h+='</div></div>';
    }
    h+='<div style="background:white;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);">';
    h+='<div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#0288d1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:10px;">📅 7-Day Forecast</div>';
    w.daily.time.forEach((d,i)=>{
      const dt=new Date(d+'T12:00:00');
      const dn=i===0?'Today':i===1?'Tomorrow':WDAYS[dt.getDay()];
      h+='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:0.5px solid #f0f0f0;">';
      h+='<div style="width:76px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#333;">'+dn+'</div>';
      h+='<div style="font-size:20px;width:30px;">'+wIcon(w.daily.weathercode[i])+'</div>';
      h+='<div style="flex:1;font-size:10px;color:#888;">💨'+Math.round(w.daily.windspeed_10m_max[i])+'km '+wDir(w.daily.winddirection_10m_dominant[i])+', ☔'+(w.daily.precipitation_probability_max[i]||0)+'%</div>';
      h+='<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#e53935;">'+Math.round(w.daily.temperature_2m_max[i])+'°</div>';
      h+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:#aaa;margin-left:5px;">'+Math.round(w.daily.temperature_2m_min[i])+'°</div></div>';
    });
    h+='</div>';
    wx.innerHTML=h;
  })
  .catch(()=>{
    wx.innerHTML='<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0288d1,#00acc1);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;color:white;"><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:0.8;margin-bottom:4px;">📍 La Fortuna, Costa Rica</div><div style="font-size:32px;font-weight:800;">22 to 30°C</div><div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:4px;">🌤️ Tropical rainforest, humid year round</div><div style="font-size:11px;margin-top:6px;opacity:0.8;">💨 Mild breeze, more wind near the lake</div></div>';
  });
}
</script>
